title: Borgar Haug edges Chen Junsong 21-19 in the decider to reach the WTT Star Contender Muscat main draw
seo_title: WTT Star Contender Muscat qualifying: Haug beats Chen 21-19
description: Borgar Haug won a 21-19 decider against Chen Junsong as Kang Dongsoo, Tang Yiren, Sun Yang and Yuan Licen came through WTT Star Contender Muscat qualifying.
standfirst: The Norwegian won the longest game of the tournament so far to knock out the fourth seed in qualifying, while Istanbul runner-up Kang Dongsoo beat the top seed and three of China's eight men came through.
body: Borgar Haug reached the main draw of WTT Star Contender Muscat on Tuesday by beating China's Chen Junsong 6-11, 11-8, 11-4, 8-11, 21-19, winning a deciding game that ran 19 points past the usual finish.

The 23-year-old Norwegian, ranked 109th, had lost the first game and was pegged back to 2-2 by Chen, the world No 86 and fourth seed in qualifying. Neither could pull clear in the fifth, which went to 21-19, the longest game of the tournament so far. The match lasted 46 minutes.
Haug, who had beaten France's Vincent Picard 3-1 in the morning, is one of eight men who came through the three rounds of men's qualifying. The main draw starts on Wednesday.
## Kang Dongsoo beats the top seed

Kang Dongsoo, the South Korean defender who lost to Fang Bo in the [WTT Contender Istanbul final](/news/wtt-contender-istanbul-2026-finals-fang-bo-honoka-hashimoto-titles.html) on Sunday, kept his run going with two wins. He beat China's Zhou Jinquan 11-8, 11-9, 13-11 in the second round and then the top seed in qualifying, France's Léo de Nodrest, 8-11, 15-13, 11-7, 11-4.

Kang, 32, climbed 52 places to world No 68 in Monday's ranking after Istanbul, four places behind de Nodrest. After losing a second game that went to 15-13, de Nodrest won only 11 points in the last two.
South Korea also have Kwon Hyuk in the main draw. The 18-year-old beat Russia's Denis Ivonin 3-0 and then his compatriot Ma Yeongmin 11-5, 12-10, 11-8 in 20 minutes.

China started men's qualifying with eight players and finish it with three. Tang Yiren, 17, lost the first game to France's Alexis Kouraichi 12-10 and then dropped only 17 points in the next three. Sun Yang, an 18-year-old defender ranked 228th, beat Croatia's Ivor Ban, the world No 94, 11-5 in the fifth game of a 48-minute match, and then swept France's Esteban Dorr 11-2, 14-12, 11-5.

Yuan Licen had the longest match of the final round. He won the first two games against France's Lilian Bardet, the first of them 19-17, let Bardet back in to 2-2 and took the decider 11-7 after 52 minutes.

Ao Hualei and Zhou Jinquan went out in the second round. De Nodrest beat Ao 3-2, taking the fifth game 11-8 after Ao had pulled level from two games down. Together with Chen and Monday's defeats for Zhai Jiale and Quan Kaiyuan, that leaves five of China's eight men out before the main draw.
## Ionescu and Tanaka complete the eight

Romania's Eduard Ionescu, who went through the second round on a walkover when Fang Bo [withdrew injured](/news/fang-bo-withdraws-wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026-injury-treatment.html), beat Russia's Maksim Grebnev 3-2, taking the decider 11-8. Japan's Yuta Tanaka, the second seed in qualifying, edged South Korea's Lim Yunoh 12-10 in the fifth game in the morning and beat Kazakhstan's Iskender Kharki 3-1 in the afternoon. Kharki had knocked out Croatia's Filip Zeljko, who beat Dimitrij Ovtcharov in the Bundesliga last week.

In doubles qualifying, Chen and Tang beat Kang and Lim 3-1, and France's Simon Gauzy and Flavien Coton came from two games down to beat Iran's Navid and Hamid Shams 3-2. Feng Yixuan and Fan Shuhan beat their teammates Yang Huize and Wei Jingming 11-9, 12-10, 11-9 in the only women's doubles qualifier.

- Men's singles, qualifying round three (winners reach the main draw): Kang Dongsoo (KOR) bt Léo de Nodrest (FRA) 8-11, 15-13, 11-7, 11-4; Kwon Hyuk (KOR) bt Ma Yeongmin (KOR) 11-5, 12-10, 11-8; Borgar Haug (NOR) bt Chen Junsong (CHN) 6-11, 11-8, 11-4, 8-11, 21-19; Tang Yiren (CHN) bt Alexis Kouraichi (FRA) 10-12, 11-9, 11-3, 11-5; Yuan Licen (CHN) bt Lilian Bardet (FRA) 19-17, 11-9, 8-11, 7-11, 11-7; Eduard Ionescu (ROU) bt Maksim Grebnev (RUS) 11-7, 7-11, 7-11, 11-6, 11-8; Sun Yang (CHN) bt Esteban Dorr (FRA) 11-2, 14-12, 11-5; Yuta Tanaka (JPN) bt Iskender Kharki (KAZ) 11-6, 11-3, 9-11, 11-4
- Men's singles, qualifying round two: Léo de Nodrest (FRA) bt Ao Hualei (CHN) 11-6, 11-5, 9-11, 9-11, 11-8; Kang Dongsoo (KOR) bt Zhou Jinquan (CHN) 11-8, 11-9, 13-11; Ma Yeongmin (KOR) bt Kay Stumper (GER) 11-2, 12-10, 11-6; Kwon Hyuk (KOR) bt Denis Ivonin (RUS) 11-5, 11-6, 11-5; Chen Junsong (CHN) bt Amir Hossein Hodaei (IRI) 12-10, 11-7, 11-4; Borgar Haug (NOR) bt Vincent Picard (FRA) 5-11, 11-5, 11-9, 11-7; Tang Yiren (CHN) bt Jo Yokotani (JPN) 11-6, 11-7, 11-9; Alexis Kouraichi (FRA) bt Ebrahim Gubran (YEM) 11-8, 11-7, 11-7; Lilian Bardet (FRA) bt Ibrahima Diaw (DEN) 11-7, 11-7, 11-9; Yuan Licen (CHN) bt Lee Seungsoo (KOR) 5-11, 11-3, 12-10, 11-5; Maksim Grebnev (RUS) bt Aditya Sareen (AUS) 11-8, 11-9, 11-9; Eduard Ionescu (ROU) w/o Fang Bo (KAZ); Sun Yang (CHN) bt Ivor Ban (CRO) 15-13, 7-11, 11-8, 10-12, 11-5; Esteban Dorr (FRA) bt Niagol Stoyanov (ITA) 12-10, 12-10, 11-5; Iskender Kharki (KAZ) bt Filip Zeljko (CRO) 3-11, 15-13, 11-5, 11-5; Yuta Tanaka (JPN) bt Lim Yunoh (KOR) 7-11, 11-7, 7-11, 11-8, 12-10
- Men's doubles, qualifying: Simon Gauzy / Flavien Coton (FRA) bt Navid Shams / Hamid Shams (IRI) 9-11, 8-11, 11-7, 11-1, 11-6; Chen Junsong / Tang Yiren (CHN) bt Kang Dongsoo / Lim Yunoh (KOR) 10-12, 11-8, 11-9, 11-7; Ryoichi Yoshiyama / Ryuusei Kawakami (JPN) bt Lubomir Jancarik / Aditya Sareen (CZE/AUS) 11-7, 12-10, 11-7; Andrei Istrate / Iulian Chirita (ROU) bt Park Ganghyeon / An Jaehyun (KOR) 11-7, 11-8, 11-9
- Mixed doubles, qualifying: Ibrahim Gunduz / Yoo Siwoo (TUR/KOR) bt Iskender Kharki / Sarvinoz Mirkadirova (KAZ) 13-15, 11-4, 9-11, 11-5, 12-10; Yuan Licen / Wang Xiaotong (CHN) bt Ma Yeongmin / Kim Seongjin (KOR) 11-8, 11-3, 11-9; Jo Yokotani / Cocona Muramatsu (JPN) bt Niagol Stoyanov / Giorgia Piccolin (ITA) 9-11, 11-5, 11-4, 5-11, 11-3; Kwon Hyuk / Yoo Yerin (KOR) bt Wim Verdonschot / Yuan Wan (GER) 11-9, 11-6, 12-14, 11-8
- Women's doubles, qualifying: Feng Yixuan / Fan Shuhan (CHN) bt Yang Huize / Wei Jingming (CHN) 11-9, 12-10, 11-9

The main draw starts on Wednesday, with Darko Jorgic, Shunsuke Togami and Germany's Dang Qiu the top three seeds in the men's singles. Tanaka turns 26 on Wednesday. The main draw had not been published by late Tuesday afternoon; follow it and every match on [Eleven's event page](/events/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026.html#matches).
